principle: Rules are additional scientific audit criteria, selected, adjusted, and versioned for each project. They are not a fixed execution workflow or regulatory certification.
activation_policy: Only after explicit user review; no automatic import into proposal rules or runtime criteria.

rules.title: Define intended use and estimands
rules.proposal: State whether the goal is description, index screening, or human extrapolation, with evidence requirements for each.
rules.avoid: Treating successful fitting as validated human prediction

source.title: FDA Population Pharmacokinetics (2022)
source.section: V.C: validation for the intended use

rules.title: Identify experimental units and replicates
rules.proposal: Record animals/subjects, strains, wells, repeated samples, and group summaries separately to avoid pseudoreplication.
rules.scope: Animal studies; define in vitro experimental units separately
rules.avoid: Counting each blood sample as an independent animal or reconstructing individuals from means

source.title: ARRIVE 2.0 — experimental unit
source.section: Essential 10, 1b; applying this to in vitro work is a project-specific extension

rules.unknown_handling: Report gaps; defer inference pending confirmation

rules.title: Assess data amount and coverage for the task
rules.proposal: Use parameter precision, identifiability, and time/dose coverage to assess adequacy; no fixed species count.
rules.scope: Tasks requiring parameter estimation or prediction
rules.avoid: Automatically declaring three species or a fixed N adequate

source.title: FDA Population Pharmacokinetics (2022)
source.section: V.C.1: parameter precision and data support

rules.title: Trace assay quality, LLOQ, and BLQ
rules.proposal: Record quantification method, matrix, and LLOQ; distinguish missing values, BLQ, and true zeros.
rules.scope: Quantitative concentrations; record gaps in public-source documentation
rules.avoid: Declaring data invalid solely because assay-validation documentation is unavailable

source.title: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation (2022)
source.section: Assay fitness-for-purpose principles; state encoding is a proposed software implementation

rules.unknown_handling: Preserve the original state; follow the project analysis plan

rules.title: Establish biological plausibility and parameter meaning
rules.proposal: Support structures, covariates, and parameter definitions pharmacologically; distinguish apparent and absolute parameters.
rules.scope: PK structural models and cross-species comparisons
rules.avoid: Applying the same parameter range or fixed allometric exponent to every drug

source.title: FDA Population Pharmacokinetics (2022)
source.section: V.B; CL/F checks are implementation proposals based on model definitions

rules.unknown_handling: Check units, model conventions, and applicability

rules.title: Match free/total exposure, MIC, and infection site
rules.proposal: Prioritize free exposure; justify total concentrations and match binding, MIC, and tissue matrix.
rules.scope: Antimicrobial PK/PD; not automatically applicable to other drug classes
rules.avoid: Uncritically using another species' binding or treating lung homogenate as ELF
rules.unknown_handling: Do not calculate indices when critical conversion evidence is missing

rules.title: Confirm PD endpoints and observation windows in advance
rules.proposal: Define effect scale, baseline, time window, and strain; retain non-estimability when target effects are not reached.
rules.avoid: Requiring the same bacterial kill magnitude for every drug
rules.unknown_handling: Do not pool different times/endpoints as one comparison

rules.title: Use comparable conditions for information criteria
rules.proposal: Check observation sets, response scales, and likelihood comparability before ranking by AIC/BIC.
rules.avoid: Directly ranking AIC values from different datasets

source.title: R stats — AIC
source.section: Details: likelihood and data conditions across fits

rules.unknown_handling: Stop that ranking; retain individual fit results where appropriate

rules.title: Assess uncertainty, convergence, and shrinkage together
rules.proposal: Report estimation uncertainty and diagnostics; review the reliability of individual exposure estimates separately.
rules.scope: Parameter estimation; shrinkage only for applicable population models
rules.avoid: Using RSE<30% or a convergence flag as a universal acceptance threshold

source.title: FDA Population Pharmacokinetics (2022)
source.section: V.C.1: the consequences of shrinkage depend on intended use

rules.unknown_handling: Flag non-identifiability or limits of use; configure thresholds per project

rules.title: Separate predictive checks from goodness of fit
rules.proposal: Choose diagnostics, predictive checks, and independent validation for the intended use; describe the validation scope.
rules.scope: Models used for prediction or translation
rules.avoid: Treating the highest R² or lowest AIC as proof of clinical reliability

source.title: FDA Population Pharmacokinetics (2022)
source.section: V.C: complementary validation methods selected for intended use

rules.unknown_handling: Limit conclusions when evidence does not support the intended use

rules.title: Define the animal/in vitro-to-human bridge
rules.proposal: Record species, infection-state, and population differences; label predictions without human PK as awaiting validation.
rules.avoid: Treating animal targets or scenario PTA as a validated human regimen

source.title: EMA Antimicrobial PK/PD guideline (2016; effective 2017)
source.section: 4.3–4.4: preclinical exploratory work can still proceed

rules.unknown_handling: Retain translational research; do not claim validated human dosing recommendations

rules.title: Review regimen feasibility and safety separately
rules.proposal: Assess effects, practical dosing constraints, and safety endpoints; unsupported thresholds remain unassessable.
rules.avoid: Automatically declaring a regimen safe because target attainment is high

source.title: FDA Exposure–Response Relationships (2003)
source.section: Clinical use and exposure–benefit/adverse-effect relationships; feasibility checklists are project proposals

rules.unknown_handling: Record limitations; gather evidence or open another cycle
